verified.story_title: Alaska Advances 403 Rural Health Proposals Toward $272M in Federal Transformation Funding
claims_to_strip: TCC drone delivery specifically to '27 villages' — the 27-villages figure belongs to a separate TCC prevention program, not the drone-delivery proposal. Do not attach a village count to drone delivery.
confirmed_facts: Alaska advanced 403 of ~1,800 letters of interest
$272 million first-year allocation (exact $272,174,855.72 per Alaska DOH)
Rep. Genevieve Mina quote verbatim: 'You name a program transformation, but the way that the feds designed it is almost directing us to AI'
TCC drone-delivery proposal advanced (no specific village count)
Workforce and Technology/AI are core RHTP initiative tracks; workforce commitments run five years
verified.industry_consequence: Alaska's largest-ever federal health influx structurally favors AI-enabled telehealth, remote monitoring, and digital tools over facility construction. It creates immediate procurement opportunity for health-tech and AI vendors and sets a five-year workforce/technology track that gates the money on sustained rural staffing.
verified.validator_note: Three independent in-window news sources plus one primary agency page (background). All headline facts confirmed. Strip the '27 villages' drone attribution.

verified.story_title: Trump Signs AI Innovation and Security EO; CISA and Treasury Face 30-Day Deadlines
confirmed_facts: EO 'Promoting Advanced Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Security' signed June 2, published Federal Register June 5, 2026
30-day deadline on CISA to issue binding directives and expand AI-enabled cyber tools
30-day deadline on Treasury (with NSA, CISA) to establish an AI cybersecurity clearinghouse
Named beneficiary classes verbatim: 'rural hospitals, community banks, and local utilities'

sources.author: Federal Register
sources.note: CAPTCHA wall; does not count toward sourcing rule.

verified.industry_consequence: A 30-day federal compliance clock (about July 2) for Alaska's rural hospitals, electric cooperatives, and community banks to engage new CISA AI-cybersecurity tools. Alaska's distributed critical infrastructure and thin rural IT staffing make the named classes directly exposed.
verified.validator_note: White House primary source resolves and confirms every claim. Federal Register blocked (CAPTCHA) but does not affect verification. In-window via June 5 FR publication.

verified.story_title: Air Force RFLP for AI Data Centers at JBER/Eielson/Clear; Proposals Due June 29; Community Pushback
claims_to_strip: Do not cite a 'May 8' posting date. RFLP AFCEC-26-R-0006 originally posted April 10, updated June 5 (in-window).
Hedge '~4,700 acres / up to 12 parcels / up to 50 years' as early reporting (single out-of-window source, Air & Space Forces).
confirmed_facts: RFLP AFCEC-26-R-0006 for commercial AI data centers at JBER, Eielson AFB, Clear SFS
Updated June 5; proposals due June 29 (extended from May 29)
June 8-9 community pushback near Eielson (water, noise, permafrost, GVEA grid load); Air Force declined written questions
verified.industry_consequence: A June 29 bid deadline puts AI compute infrastructure on three Alaska installations. GVEA grid capacity, NEPA permitting, and community opposition near Eielson are the near-term gatekeepers bidders must price in.
verified.validator_note: Date discrepancy resolved (posted April 10, updated June 5). In-window via June 5 update + June 8-9 community response. AI nexus direct (solicitation names AI data centers). Hedge single-sourced acreage figures.
